project_types_supported.mapping_note: The ingestion types (projectType x ownership) are the closest match to canon and could map 1:1 (FOUNDER+PERSONAL->PERSONAL_PROJECT, CLIENT->CLIENT_PROJECT, SITE00+INTERNAL->INTERNAL_SITE00_PROJECT) but only JURNL uses them and nothing server-side reads them.

gaps: No single authoritative registry; 7+ static TS lists and the DB disagree on membership, type vocabulary, and slug spelling.
Canonical project-type enum (FOUNDER/PERSONAL/CLIENT/INTERNAL_SITE00) does not exist anywhere.
JURNL exists only client-side (no DB row, no server capability, no API authorization path).
AIO is registered as a founder MANAGED_BRAND with no owner binding; its real owner cannot be invited.
Projects are created by founder intake conversion (adminOperations.ts:1010-1035) or post-payment activation (clientStudio.ts:553-605) — no 'founder creates project then invites client' flow.
Adding a project requires editing multiple code registries + capability map + (optionally) a migration seed.
